basic_info.description: Welcome to 170 26th Avenue in sought-after Sea Cliff. This single family residence offers a formal floor plan spanning three levels of living.  The 1909 home has a formal entry foyer, adjacent is a living room, dining room, bath and large eat in kitchen. The kitchen has walk out access to a deck with direct access to the well-kept back yard. Up on the second level there are four bedrooms and two bathrooms. On the third level there is a pent-room with Golden Gate Bridge views; ideal as an office, bedroom or TV room. The deep garage has lots of space for storage and direct access to the yard. Behind the garage is a self-contained suite; perfect as your home gym or art studio.  This home offers great indoor / outdoor living and is ideally located in within short walk to Baker Beach, China Beach, Burke's, the Presidio and Land's End trail.
